create_BitMasks: create a BitMasks object from a tensor of segmentation masks representing N instances in an image
build_PolygonMasks: build a PolygonMasks object from a list of polygon coordinate arrays per instance
convert_polygon_masks_to_bitmasks: convert polygon masks to bitmap masks using BitMasks.from_polygon_masks with given image height and width
crop_and_resize_bitmasks: crop and resize bitmask instances to a fixed square size using bounding box coordinates
rasterize_polygons_within_box: rasterize polygon coordinates into a resized binary mask tensor cropped to a bounding box
